thread:
marta: Customer hit intermittent 502s + high p99 on /v1/chat after yesterday's canary. They said stable seemed fine before.
ryan: ugh. any reqids? region? model?
marta: reqid=7f3a2b9c, another=7f3a2b9d. region=us-west-2. Route=/v1/chat. Model header on their traffic: \"model: rw-gpt-13b-v2\" but they also said they pinned to rw-gpt-13b-q4f32-v2 for a week.
support-bot: Please collect a debug bundle with the customer's repro reqids: `rw-debug collect --req 7f3a2b9c,7f3a2b9d --include=traces,logs --out=customer-1812345678.tar.gz`
simone: can you forward the curl they used or give me an example? trying to reproduce locally on canary pool.
marta: they gave this curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-13b-q4f32-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize..."}],"max_tokens":256}'
```
ryan: i ran that against canary and got a 502 after 2.1s, exact body: `{"error":"upstream_timeout","code":502}`. attaching short logs.
kevin: paste of runtime logs around req 7f3a2b9c:
```
[2026-03-16T21:12:11Z] INFO  route=/v1/chat reqid=7f3a2b9c pool=canary-03 model=rw-gpt-13b-q4f32-v2 seq=1 lat=2100ms upstream=nv-infer-12 status=502
[2026-03-16T21:12:11Z] WARN  kv-cache-miss model=rw-gpt-13b-q4f32-v2 key=abcdef
[2026-03-16T21:12:11Z] ERROR runtime kernel-fallback triggered, reason=oom-estimate
```
simone: interesting see kernel-fallback + kv-cache-miss. last week we changed kernel pins for q4f32 builds on canary. could be a bad kernel/quant combo.
marta: customer also reported auth hiccups earlier today — 401 for a subset of requests. not sure if related.
ryan: pulled sample trace: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/abc123 (shows queue spiking then 502). queue depth jumps before kernel fallback.
support-bot: Checklist: 1) collect debug bundle (logs, traces, runtime config) 2) get curl repro 3) confirm model pin metadata 4) note whether they used dedicated vs hosted 5) collect timestamped token/usage for billing path.
kevin: i'm going to try repro with model pinned vs unpinned; if pinned to q4f32 we might force same kernel selection locally.
simone: if you reproduce, try forcing `REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=legacy` env too — see if fallback disappears.
ryan: quick repro steps I used (can reproduce 70%):
```
# run against canary pool with same model header
export RW_API_HOST=canary.api.redwood.ai
curl -s -X POST $RW_API_HOST/v1/chat -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d @payload.json
```
payload.json contains the same messages and `model=rw-gpt-13b-q4f32-v2`.
marta: customer asked if pinning to stable would avoid this — they prefer a quick workaround.
simone: short-term: advise customer to pin to `rw-gpt-13b-v2` (stable) and we rollback kernel changes on canary if repro confirmed. long-term: add better kernel-canary health checks + automatic rollback.
kevin: i'm capturing perf counters and will attach a debug bundle here when done.
ryan: also seeing billing anomalies: some of their failed calls still charged as partial tokens. ops: can we check billing pipeline for charged failures?
support-bot: Billing note: failed requests with 5xx should be refunded automatically, but we need the debugbundle+reqids to verify.
marta: i'm sending customer the debug collect command and asking them to pin to stable for now.
simone: if you want me to run a controlled canary repro, tag me and i'll spin up a replica with the exact quantization kernels.
kevin: uploaded bundle -> https://s3.redwood.ai/bugs/1812345678/db.tar.gz (internal)
ryan: thanks — pulling now. priority P1 until we confirm kernel regression on canary.
deploy-bot: Canary pools for rw-gpt-13b-q4f32-v2 temporarily throttled at 2026-03-16T22:05:00Z due to elevated 502 rates.
marta: noted. i'll update the customer and ask them to confirm if pinning to stable removes 502s. :thumbsup:
kevin: preliminary: kernel-fallback + high queue depth caused by a rare OOM estimate in the new kernel path. rolling back kernel pin on canary looks to reduce 502s in quick test.
simone: next steps: 1) confirm with customer after stable-pin 2) rollback canary kernel pins + monitor 3) add regression test for q4f32 kernel combos.
marta: thanks team — i'll keep thread updated with customer confirmation.
